title: Accessibility review
whenToUse: Need WCAG-oriented review of a UI change.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
a11y review of {{surface}} targeting {{level}}.

CONTEXT:
Framework: {{framework}}.

INPUT:
{{codeOrUrl}}

CONSTRAINTS:
- Name, roles, keyboard, contrast notes
- Prefer native semantics

OUTPUT:
Issues + fixes

ACCEPTANCE:
Blocking a11y issues listed.

VERIFICATION:
Suggest axe/keyboard checks.
improvedPrompt: Review icon button names, dialog focus trap, and contrast on muted text.
